## Result

- Skill: delivery-review.
- Review status: approved.
- Package members: registered primary plan — docs/plans/2026-09-09-release-model-source-consolidation.md. Remaining subjects are governing or contextual evidence, not extra Delivery members.
- Upstream review ID: design-review-r6; current direction proposal-review-r7.
- Review ID and round: delivery-review-r3, round 3.
- Traceability result: sufficient whole-plan REL-SR-01–24/System/Design/R7–R8 allocation, including the bounded M5/TG-09 addition and renewed TG-FINAL-01.
- Material findings: none.
- Correction targets: none.
- Recording status: recorded upon successful targeted persistence.
- Open blockers: none to this Delivery decision; known implementation/CI correction remains required work.
- Immediate next stage: return to route for authorized M5 execution.
- Claim limitations: approves allocation and sequencing only. No implementation completion, corrected CI, current final Code Review, Verify, push, hosted setup or publication success.

## Independence and exact basis

The reviewer authored none of the proposal, Design, plan, implementation or tests. Prior participation was independent Delivery and Code Review with original-reporter dispositions. Read the complete revised primary plan, exact Release amendment, current upstream review bodies and subjects, wrapper implementation, canonical tests, selector invocation/path classification and actual failing fixture setup. Current Proposal r7 and Design r6 exact subjects match the inspected files. Preserve prior Delivery r1/r2 and all milestone/final judgments with their original identities; this review does not retarget them or initialize/update existing work.

The unchanged M1–M4 allocations retain their previously assessed complete requirement-to-boundary-to-proof trace: immutable candidate and actual archive/metadata/index/packed chain; provider-bound authority and uncertain-write recovery; actual CLI/protected workflow and durable evidence; exact source retirement with current-owner and historical-reliance disposition. No numbered requirement or those milestone allocations changed. Their prior Delivery analysis remains applicable as planning reasoning, not a claim that earlier runtime passes prove the revised scripts or detached environment. Current r6 command disposition is the governing source for this refinement; early source-artifact/r4 labels in the plan describe original allocation history, not an instruction to rely on removed sources or obsolete assessment identities.

## M5 sequencing and protective proof

M5 follows completed M1–M4 and current independent upstream approval. It selects exactly one withdrawn executable alias and its exclusive delegation test, plus the bounded detached-fixture correction and explanatory deleted-path selection. Direct inspection confirms the wrapper merely forwards --recorded-source-auto and the selector already invokes validate-release.py with that option. Canonical tests separately exercise recorded-commit selection, error propagation, metadata validation and missing/stale/malformed resource protection. The plan requires retaining those distinct checks and meaningful standalone preparation/preflight/closeout paths. Deletion is justified by the explicit retired entrypoint, not test count or age. No production authorization, workflow permission or canonical algorithm change is allocated.

TG-09 connects REL-SR-06/08/09/14/19/21/22 and the compatibility scenario to actual retained canonical and negative checks, deleted-path selection, and the real composed candidate fixture from detached Git state. The inspected fixture uses branch -M main after cloning, which requires an attached current branch; the reported hosted failure therefore has a concrete allocated environmental counterexample. The plan requires preserving that failure and a failing-before local reproduction, explicitly selecting detached input, and executing the corrected real candidate/CLI path. It does not delete the failing integration case or authorize changing production behavior to make it green. Branch creation is confined to temporary repositories.

The commands exist and discovery already reaches the relevant tests. Adapter, release-transaction and selector suites plus complete immutable PR-range CI are proportional: the range mode accounts for deletion, while rebuilding the candidate is necessary because scripts are identity-bearing candidate inputs. The explicit-path limitation from prior deletion work is not silently treated as a pass. A full selected run may supply the required suites without redundant repetition, but actual selection and nonzero discovery must be inspected. Retained negative/integrity protection and actual composed-path proof remain mandatory; helper success is insufficient.

## Final applicability and handoff

TG-FINAL-01 now covers M1–M5. M5 explicitly requires new candidate proof and complete final engineering-range checks, independent milestone Code Review, fresh whole-change final Code Review and distinct Verify. Earlier final passes cannot establish current readiness after script inventory, fixture and environment changes. Source-transfer/history and unchanged lower-level evidence may inform final assessment only with affirmative unaffected-surface justification; the known hosted failure remains contrary evidence until supported correction and replacement observation.

The plan separates local implementation/review/Verify from replacement hosted PR CI observation after the separately authorized push. Read its hosted-outcome evidence requirement together with its explicit post-update observation ordering: it does not require pushing before local review/Verify or claim local tests establish hosted success. Final PR handoff must report the actual replacement head/run outcome. No real release, remote configuration or customer installation is selected. Recovery restores only the bounded alias/test/selector slice if equivalence fails and preserves all prior judgments/failure evidence.

## Checks and limits

Actually performed: full plan read; exact plan/Release diff inspection; current primary CLI context and subject inspect; upstream subject-byte comparisons; bounded wrapper/canonical-test/selector/fixture reads; targeted review recording. No runtime suite or hosted run was executed by this Delivery review, and no author-reported correction pass is adopted as completed M5 proof. Scoped record-store validation and git diff --check follow persistence. No engineering, plan, work or activity edits are made.
independence_basis: Independent nonauthor reviewed complete revised primary plan and exact current approved Design; prior participation was assessment only, with no engineering or routing authorship.
